title: Native answer submission (PROPOSED, DEL-01-04/NIR-v0.1 §4.5)
description: PROPOSED by DEL-01-04/NIR-v0.1 (R17-1). What the request card hands to the register's 'answer' operation (HOSTING-BOUNDARY-v0.8 §6.4; custody DEL-01-02). The native answer is the supplier's own response content at the 0.158.0 definition pin, unchanged and never translated (REQ-001; V4-APP-04). Only the person's path is described: origin is always person-via-interaction with the actor as the App observes the person, marked identity not verified (DECISION-K1 K1-4); App rules use the register's own operations, never this format. 'submittedAs' states which the card meant; the register still decides settlement by its own rules (HOSTING RT-08; join J-H3). No placement, transport or persistence is chosen (OI-008, OI-014). Written in the subset of JSON Schema 2020-12 that DEL-04-03's prototype validator accepts.

method.description: The kinds a person answers through a card at 0.158.0 (NIR §4.1). Other kinds are never answered by a person (HOSTING R9).

nativeAnswer.description: The response content exactly as written to the supplier.

formsOffered.description: Names of the forms the card showed (NIR FO-1...FO-6), so a reader can see the answer was among them.

secretValuesPresent.description: True when an answer to an isSecret question is in nativeAnswer: the register must not persist those values in readable form (NIR SE-1; join J-H4).

allOf.description: Tool-permission kinds answer with a decision.
The legacy 'timed_out' form is never a person's answer (HOSTING R3; R17-9).
Extra permissions answer with a profile and a scope.
Questions answer with a map of question identity to answers.
